purpose: fixed-model causal structural diagnostic; no optimization and no trading-performance claims
sampleSelection: purposive liquid cross-market sample fixed before fetching outcomes; not representative of full universe
holdoutPolicy: Chronological final third reserved from tuning. Aggregate diagnostics are observed here, so this is not an untouched final holdout for later development; later changes require a new untouched period/symbol set.
prefixCheck: every completed daily bar; compare immutable decisions and pivots to full replay truncated at availability
regime: causal SMA50/SMA200: up when close>50>200; down when close<50<200; mixed otherwise; insufficient history before 200 bars
caseSelection: first chronological signal in each direction and first example per final rejection reason; no performance selection
limits: current survivor universe and retrospectively revised quotes
two-year sample does not span all market cycles
no historical 4H execution or portfolio performance in this stage
